title: Spring WebFlux & Reactive Programming
intro: Spring WebFlux interview questions test whether you understand reactive programming on the JVM — Mono vs Flux, backpressure, the Project Reactor operator vocabulary, Schedulers and threading, when reactive helps versus when it just adds complexity, and the migration patterns from blocking Spring MVC. This page is small but focused: each question is one a senior interviewer actually asks when WebFlux is on your resume.
